annotations.text: v2 — the cohesive shell (Option A palette, new information architecture). Same data, many views, one persistent nav. How the pieces interoperate ↓

ONE SHELL, MANY VIEWS
The left-nav view switch (Board · Timeline · Calendar · My Work · Portfolio) shows the SAME filtered tasks through different lenses. Switching a view keeps your project/entity/filter context — you never re-filter.

DETAIL = SIDE PANEL, NOT A MODAL
Clicking a card opens the task in a docked right panel; the board stays visible and you can click card→card. Replaces the ~8 blocking dialogs of v1.

CROSS-LINKS (interoperability)
• Portfolio entity card → opens the Board filtered to that entity
• A notification, a global-search hit, or a critical-path bar → opens that task in the side panel, in context
• My Work item → jumps to it in its project

IN-PLACE, LOW-FRICTION ACTIONS
• Drag a card between sections (Board)
• Drag a Gantt bar to reschedule → creates a schedule PROPOSAL (ties into the baseline/approve model already built)
• Inline title/owner edit · quick-add a task inside a section
v1 — the first screens (dashboard + modal-per-feature). Superseded by the shell on the 'v2' page; kept here for reference so we can compare the old flow with the new one.
